verdict.line: Buy only below $2,880 psf. A 3-bed here at about $2,660 to $2,860 psf is a little above what the closest competitors' 3-bed-size resales support (about $2,740 psf as a new launch), so aim for the lower end. 3-bed and 4-bed are the most wanted sizes in this own-stay family area.
reasons: The closest competitors (Chuan Park, The Scala, Cardiff Residence) work out to about $2,740 psf as a brand-new launch, after adding 5% where they were not built under the harmonised floor-area rules, a 33% new-launch premium (what launches selling now in the OCR charge over their closest resale, 13 launches).

The Scala (149 m away, 468 homes, completed 2013): its 3-bed-size resales (about 760 to 1,030 sq ft) averaged $1,989 psf over the last 6 months (5 resales), against a median $1,991 psf for all sizes. A 3-bed here at about $2,757 psf is $768 psf (+39%) above that; a 3-bed there sold for a median $2.10M.
Bought at the expected $2,757 psf, the base case makes about +20% after stamp duty and selling costs by 2031 (4.8% a year); bought at $2,740 psf it makes about +21%.

Who can buy a 3-bed from you (tested at today's $2.46M; about $3.15M by 2031 in the base case): HDB 5-room upgraders yes; HDB 4-room upgraders no; Landed owners right-sizing yes; Condo owners nearby moving or upgrading yes. Resale pool: wide.
verdict.suits: Buyers who can buy at or below about $2,880 psf and plan to live here for 5 years or more. Most buyers at resale will be HDB upgraders from Serangoon, Ang Mo Kio and Bishan, plus private-to-private movers and families chasing St.

priceA: Two URA parcels, $1,376 and $1,331 psf ppr; blended $1,355 (our division of the total price by combined floor area). psf ppr = land price per square foot of floor area the site may build.
Building, finance, fees and other costs
EdgeProp's break-even method: about 1.36 times the land price plus $459 psf (it matches all 29 EdgeProp break-evens in our data).
The price at which the developer only covers its costs. A launch below this is unlikely.
Launches since 2023 priced on average 27% above their break-even (range 15% to 42%, 16 launches).
compsNote: 3 of the 3 competitors are within 1 km. Near-twins come first: up to two condos within 1.5 km with a similar number of homes (half to double) completed in 2016 or later. Then every suitable condo within 1 km (same tenure, completed 2011 or later first), widening to 2 km and 3 km only if fewer than 3; executive condos are left out. Resale prices are URA medians for the last 6 months where there were at least 5 resales, otherwise the last 12 months. Condos launched before June 2023 measured their areas under the old rules (including air-con ledges), so their psf is raised 5% to compare like for like.
priceDecide: Like for like by size: for each unit type we take each resale competitor's average psf for units within about 15% of that size (last 6 months, or 12 or 24 if too few). Each is raised by the 33% new-launch premium that launches selling now in the OCR carry over their closest resale (13 launches). Buy at or below = the average of the competitors' new-launch equivalents for that size; walk away above = 5% more. 2-bed: buy at or below $2,700, walk away above $2,840, this project about $2,861 psf; 3-bed: buy at or below $2,740, walk away above $2,880, this project about $2,757 psf; 4-bed: buy at or below $2,410, walk away above $2,530, this project about $2,666 psf; 5-bed: buy at or below $2,700, walk away above $2,840, this project about $2,588 psf. This project's price by unit type follows how psf changes with size among the competitors (smaller units usually cost more per sq ft).  The developer breaks even at about $2,300 psf (EdgeProp's method); launches since 2023 priced on average 27% above break-even, which points to about $2,920 psf.

gain.timeline: Buy at the reported February 2027 preview. Completion is reported for 16 July 2030 (project signboard). Seller's Stamp Duty ends in February 2031, so we test a sale about a year after TOP, in mid-2031 (4.5 years), and also 5.5 years.
gain.costs: Potential gain is after Buyer's Stamp Duty at IRAS rates, about $6,000 legal fees and a 2% agent fee plus 9% GST when you sell. Loan interest, property tax, maintenance and rent are not included.
scen: Half the base case: competing supply at the exit, or a softer market.

exit.mopNote: HDB 4-room and bigger flats completed from 2021 that reach their 5-year minimum occupation period by about 2031, in the towns resale buyers come from (HDB Property Information, data.gov.sg). New MOP flats add fresh upgraders.
exit.note: How we test each buyer group, in today's money (prices, HDB values and incomes tend to rise together): the unit at today's expected price; a 25% down payment plus Buyer's Stamp Duty; HDB upgraders put their flat's sale proceeds in first (median resale price, minus an illustrative $150,000 loan). The group can buy if that capital covers the down payment and stamp duty; the income the remaining 30-year loan needs (tested at 4% under the 55% TDSR) is shown against SingStat's 2025 averages by home type, excluding employer CPF (4-room $11,097, 5-room and executive $13,887, condo $22,006). HDB resale prices rose 4.2% a year over the past 10 years, so upgraders' capital usually grows too. Singaporean HDB owners who buy before selling pay 20% Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty upfront and get it back only if they sell the flat within 6 months (IRAS).
exit.line: In this own-stay family area, the 2-bed resale pool is wide; the 3-bed resale pool is wide; the 4-bed resale pool is good; the 5-bed resale pool is narrow.

How does it compare with Chuan Park?
Chuan Park launched at $2,579 psf in November 2024 at Lorong Chuan MRT and is 99% sold (EdgeProp). One Chuan Grove is expected at $2,600 to $2,800 psf, two years later, about 400 m from the station.
What price should I pay for a 3-bed?

fplans.note: Main layout per bedroom type (most units where counts are published), redrawn from the developers' plans in the Stacked Homes directory. Score out of 10, same rules for every plan: start at 4; +1 regular shape, dumbbell, kitchen that can be closed off, kitchen or yard window, AC ledge and planter under 5%, store or shelter or utility room; −1 long corridor, ledge and planter 10% or more, balcony over 12%. Efficiency = the share of the area not taken by AC ledges, planters, bay windows and corridors. Plans under the 2023 rules exclude AC ledges from the strata area, so their sq ft is all usable.
